_schema.description: Per-woman canon chapter availability for tools/pacing_lint.py (Writer/handoffs/13-PACING-PASS.md section 6). One entry per roster character in trickster-matrix.json; keys starting with '_' are metadata. Validated by pacing_lint.validate_availability.

entry.character: exact roster name from trickster-matrix.json (exactly one entry each)
entry.batch: pacing batch (13 section 7): PP1..PP10, or when-written (built pacing-complete under ROUTE-BRIEF-R)
entry.friendship: true for friendship-only routes (Ember, Aivu): pacing goals are trust, play and protection, never romance
entry.routes: Story.json relationships whose non-epilogue scenes are her beats: [{relationship, owners?}]; owners filters a shared relationship by scene Owner (tirabade). Must include the matrix relationship_id.
entry.present: chapter '1'..'6' -> 'ip' (in person) or 'remote' (letters only); a missing chapter means absent. The Prologue folds into '1'.
entry.exceptions: chapter -> 'none: <reason>'; coordinator-approved only; allowed only for present chapters; silences that chapter's REVIEW
entry.evidence: first_met plus one entry per present chapter, each citing a native GUID (cue, dialog, etude or unit) that pins her presence
entry.verify: true when any claim is unverified in game data
entry.verify_chapters: the present chapters whose claim is unverified (requires verify: true)
entry.sources: files and blueprint paths the entry was derived from
entry.notes: first meeting, departures, death or path conditions

Writer/handoffs/trickster/<character>.md section 1 'Canon' (verified against blueprints.zip and enGB)
Writer/handoffs/roster-candidates.json 'chapters' fields (Nenio, Eritrice, Horzalah, Chadali, Kaylessa, Dorgelinda)
Writer/handoffs/trickster-matrix.json (roster source of truth; relationship_id per character)
